title: M0 Seed the knowledge base: labeled references and first stories
description: Enter the first researched references as accepted or rejected, each with a reason tied to the editorial mission and section policy, so the Cyclotron learns both directions. Start from the October 2026 research pass (10 accepts, 5 rejects; wiki ai-at-the-uspto-2026-10). Recording curation decisions needs the agent curation-delegation route, because reviewReferenceCuration accepts only editor and admin users. Then write the first pieces from the story ideas, and repeat in research rounds.
